## String literals: double-quoted with backslash escapes. The plain
## body excludes quote and backslash; the escapes cover the classic
## five (\" \\ \n \t \r). Demonstrates alternation of escapes.
grammar StringLit version "1.0.0" edition "v2" {
  dquote = %x22
  bslash = %x5C
  ## \" \\ \n \t \r
  escape = bslash ( dquote / bslash / %x6E / %x74 / %x72 )
  plain = %x20-21 / %x23-5B / %x5D-10FFFF
  body = *( escape / plain )
  string = dquote body dquote as text

  entry main: string

  test {
    accept "\"plain\""
    accept "\"with \\\"quote\\\" inside\""
    accept "\"tab\\tnl\\nbs\\\\\""
    reject "\"unterminated"
    reject "\"bad \\x escape\""
  }
}
